title: Agent Builder — Agent Testers & Self-Improvement
description: A fixture-only laptop prototype showing persona-based synthetic testing, unified feedback evaluation, a human-reviewed Draft change and deterministic retesting.
limitations: All personas, conversations, routing, test results and recommendations are deterministic fixture behavior
No AI model, production assistant, user data or external service is called
Changes apply only to simulated local Draft state and require an explicit human-reviewed action
The Coming Soon material describes a future capability, not production functionality
